_meta.purpose: Slider/parameter sweep map for the CDP regression harness. Every entry verified in source.
sources: js/05h-slider-bindings.js (registry simSlider bindings, brushSize, resolution selects)

fieldNotes.mapping: how the DOM control value becomes the runtime value
fieldNotes.gatedBy: condition that must hold for the param to have any effect (null = always active)
fieldNotes.consumer: sim-shader = mutates stored dye/velocity sim state; display-shader = post-FX/display chain only (stored dye/velocity textures unchanged); splat = affects dye/velocity injection at stroke time

params.mapping: config.DENSITY_DISSIPATION = parseFloat(value); magnetic snap to 1.0 within +/-0.003 on trusted input events only; values < 0.88 call wipeSimulation()
params.expectedEffect: Dye persistence per frame in the advection pass: lower = paint fades faster, 1.0 = never fades, >1.0 = dye grows; below 0.88 the whole sim is wiped by the binding.
params.binding: js/05h-slider-bindings.js:569 (generic simSlider), snap 536-567, wipe 574-576; consumed js/05j-update-loop.js:1017

params.expectedEffect: Velocity field decay: lower = motion dies quickly, 1.0 = motion persists, >1.0 = growth presets (motion amplifies until VELOCITY_CAP).
Pressure field carry-over between frames (clear-program value): changes how much the incompressibility solve retains, altering swirl bounce/springiness.

params.mapping: config.PRESSURE_ITERATIONS = parseInt(value); QualityGovernor.effIters() may reduce the effective count
params.expectedEffect: Jacobi solver iteration count (fallback path when MULTIGRID is off): more = better-converged pressure, stiffer/cleaner flow; fewer = squishier, more divergent flow.

params.gatedBy: multigridToggle (config.MULTIGRID); governor budget can cap it
params.expectedEffect: Multigrid V-cycles per frame: subtle convergence-quality change in the pressure solve.
Smoother sweeps before each multigrid restriction: subtle pressure-solve quality change.
Smoother sweeps after each multigrid prolongation: subtle pressure-solve quality change.
Jacobi sweeps at the coarsest multigrid level: subtle pressure-solve quality change.
Multigrid smoother damping omega: measured near-neutral per the config comment; expect tiny or no visible change.
Curl-noise micro-swirl in dye advection: moving paint gains fine painterly wisps; settled (still) paint is untouched (0 = off, bit-stable).

params.mapping: config.WET_INFLUENCE = parseFloat(value); clamped to <=1.0 at the consumer
params.expectedEffect: Dry-Wet coupling (UI label 'Dry - Wet'): 0 = feature off (bit-identical), higher = dried paint increasingly freezes in place while freshly-painted wet paint still flows.
Wetness half-life in seconds (UI label 'Dry Time'): lower = paint sets/immobilizes faster; no effect at all while Dry-Wet is 0.

params.mapping: config.RIDGES = parseFloat(value); sharpen kernelScale = RIDGES * max(dyeW,dyeH)/2048
params.gatedBy: config.SHARPNESS > 0 AND governor fxOn (pass fully skipped otherwise)
params.expectedEffect: Sharpen kernel radius on the displayed dye: 0 = pass skipped (smooth), ~1 = classic unsharp, >1 = coarse embossed ridges; user-reported dead zone 0-20% is plausibly sub-texel kernel offsets (values below ~1 at dye 2048).
Motion isolation on stroke injection (splat shader uniform): higher = a stroke drags less of the surrounding fluid along; changes velocity imparted per dab.

params.mapping: config.CURL = parseInt(value); HIJACKED when MaterialModes is active (value becomes a material macro amount, not raw CURL)
params.expectedEffect: Vorticity confinement strength: higher = more/stronger small vortices and turbulent curling; 0 = smooth laminar flow.
Max Speed ceiling: lower = calmer bounded motion (growth presets settle lower), higher = wilder motion before the cap reins it in.

params.gatedBy: config.RIDGES > 0 AND governor fxOn (sharpen pass requires both)
params.expectedEffect: UI label 'Viscosity': strength of the sharpen pass on displayed dye; inert while Ridges is 0 (the shipped default).

params.mapping: config.SPLAT_RADIUS = value / 1000 (variance-like: dab footprint scales with sqrt of value)
params.expectedEffect: Dab size: dye and velocity footprint of every stroke; 0.001 is a ~3px hairline, 100 reaches ~63% of canvas height.
Multi-Brush arm count: each stroke deposits N symmetric dabs (layout per SYMMETRY_MODE); hotkeys 1-8 also set it.

params.mapping: window.timeScale = parseFloat(value); frame loop does dt = rawDt * timeScale
params.expectedEffect: Sim clock rate: everything (advection, decay, drying, recording playhead) runs slower/faster; per-step results at equal simulated time should match.
CSS element opacity of the canvas: dims the composited page element; GL buffer and sim state unchanged (GL readback unaffected).
Capture-UX background dimming in the display pass; cosmetic chrome, no dye/velocity change.

Number of mirror wedges in the kaleidoscope display pass.

params.expectedEffect: Toggles the micro-detail pass indirectly by zeroing/restoring clarity+vibrance config values.
Crisp advection: MacCormack error-corrected dye transport on/off - visibly sharper vs softer dye edges, different numeric dye state.
Multigrid V-cycle vs Jacobi pressure solve: different convergence, visibly different flow tightness; also gates the mg* sliders.
HDR bloom halo on/off in the display chain.
Volumetric light shafts on/off. Marches Glow's prefilter buffer toward the ray origin and adds the result alongside the halo, so it is a no-op while Glow is off.

params.mapping: config.SCATTER_AMOUNT = v*v*2.0 where v is the 0..1 slider value (SQUARED, not linear)
params.gatedBy: glowToggle AND scatterToggle AND governor fxOn
params.expectedEffect: Brightness of the light shafts, added after tone-map alongside the glow halo. The slider is normalised 0..1 and squared into the 0..2 shader gain, so the low end gets the bulk of the travel: 0.01 steps land ~0.0002 apart near zero and ~0.04 apart at the top. NOTE for sweeps: the persisted/registry value is the SLIDER value, not config.SCATTER_AMOUNT.
params.binding: js/05e-effect-controls.js (scatterAmount input); consumed js/05i-sim-stats.js (scatterProg weight uniform)

params.mapping: config.SCATTER_DENSITY = parseFloat(value) (registry lists configKey null, but the bespoke binding writes this config key)
params.gatedBy: glowToggle AND scatterToggle AND governor fxOn
params.expectedEffect: How far along each pixel's path to the ray origin it gathers light. Raises both shaft LENGTH (a distant pixel can still see the emitter) and far-field brightness (the emitter lands at a lower iteration index, so less decay has accumulated). Capped at 1.0 = march all the way to the origin.
params.binding: js/05e-effect-controls.js (scatterReach input); consumed js/05i-sim-stats.js (scatterProg density uniform)

params.gatedBy: glowToggle AND scatterToggle AND governor fxOn
params.expectedEffect: Ray origin: 'light' follows window.lightSource.x/y (regardless of lightSource.enabled); 'brush' follows window.pointer, which tracks on hover. Origin is eased by config.SCATTER_FOLLOW.

params.gatedBy: glowToggle AND scatterToggle AND collisionLayers.enabled AND an obstacle existing
params.expectedEffect: Collision layers cast shadows in the volumetric light shafts. The scatter march attenuates its transmittance when a step crosses collider coverage, so shafts break beyond a collider (shadow falls AWAY from the ray origin). Uses GEOMETRIC coverage only — the per-layer Strength slider is fluid permeability and deliberately does not dim the shadow. Measured: shafts beyond an opaque bar 1.83 -> 0.021.
params.binding: js/05e-effect-controls.js (scatterBlockToggle change); consumed js/05i-sim-stats.js (scatter pass binds obstacle to unit 1) + js/05b-shader-sim.js scatterFrag

params.mapping: config.PHOTOSAFE = checked; also writes localStorage 'fluidui.photoSafe' ('1'/'0') and toggles body.photosafe-on
params.gatedBy: nothing — NOT governor-sheddable, NOT in presets (PRESET_SKIP), NOT mutable (mutScope null)
params.expectedEffect: Photosensitivity protection (WCAG 2.3.1). Two layers: (1) an ALWAYS-ON global luminance slew clamp (PHOTOSAFE_SLEW/s) — the hard guarantee, also what covers slow sine/ramp strobes; (2) a history blend that engages only on OSCILLATION RATE — opposing large-area transitions per second above PHOTOSAFE_RATE. v2 (2026-08-21): rate replaced a per-block deviation-from-EMA test that false-positived on ordinary painting and ghosted the canvas. Verified: painting = bit-identical pass-through (envelope 0); 6Hz strobe = 14.8x attenuation.
params.binding: js/05e-effect-controls.js (photoSafeToggle change); consumed js/05j-update-loop.js (_photoSafeOn reroute) + js/05i-sim-stats.js (applyPhotoSafe)
